name: Moonhacker
fix_description: In executeOperation (flash loan callback), there is no validation that msg.sender is the Aave Pool, no check that initiator is authorized, and mToken from params is user-controlled. Anyone can call this function directly with malicious params to manipulate the contract. Fix: add require(msg.sender == address(POOL)) and require(initiator == address(this) || initiator == owner).
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is not just a trivial one-call bug: it requires understanding the vulnerable vault’s generic executeOperation flow, Moonwell mToken repay/redeem mechanics, and chaining a flash loan with repeated redeem/return-funds cycles. The PoC is still fairly compact and linear, so it’s more involved than easy but not complex enough to be hard.
